mapper.select: select ec.title, ec.cover, ec.lesson_num as lessonNum, CONVERT(ec.price, DECIMAL(8, 2)) as price, es1.title as subjectName, es2.title as typeName, et.name as teacherName from edu_course ec left OUTER JOIN edu_teacher et on ec.teacher_id = et.id left OUTER JOIN edu_subject es1 on ec.subject_id = es1.id left OUTER join edu_subject es2 on ec.type_id = es2.id where ec.id = #{courseId}

select ec.id, ec.title, ec.cover, ec.lesson_num as lessonNum, CONVERT(ec.price, DECIMAL(8, 2)) AS price, ec.sale_count as saleCount, ec.view_count as viewCount, ec.description,
et.id as teacherId, et.name as teacherName, et.intro, et.avatar,
es1.id as subjectId, es1.title as subjectName, es2.id as typeId, es2.title as typeName
from edu_course ec left OUTER JOIN edu_teacher et on ec.teacher_id = et.id left OUTER JOIN edu_subject es1 on ec.subject_id = es1.id left OUTER join edu_subject es2 on ec.type_id = es2.id where ec.id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.cover, c.description, c.price, c.sale_count as saleCount, c.view_count as viewCount, c.status, c.is_deleted as isDeleted, c.lesson_num as lessonNum, c.teacher_id as teacherId, t.name as teacherName, c.subject_id as subjectId, s1.title as subjectTitle, c.type_id as typeId, s2.title as typeTitle, c.create_time as createTime FROM edu_course c LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN edu_subject s1 ON c.subject_id = s1.id LEFT JOIN edu_subject s2 ON c.type_id = s2.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND (c.is_deleted = 0 OR c.is_deleted IS NULL)

SELECT c.id, c.title, c.cover, c.description, c.price, c.sale_count as saleCount, c.view_count as viewCount, c.status, c.is_deleted as isDeleted, c.lesson_num as lessonNum, c.teacher_id as teacherId, t.name as teacherName, c.subject_id as subjectId, s1.title as subjectTitle, c.type_id as typeId, s2.title as typeTitle, c.create_time as createTime FROM edu_course c LEFT JOIN edu_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN edu_subject s1 ON c.subject_id = s1.id LEFT JOIN edu_subject s2 ON c.type_id = s2.id WHERE c.id = #{courseId}
